incident_report.incident: Bumped shortly after the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  For a short distance near the 150 Metres was held up for clear running behind EVER SMART.
Bumped on jumping and then from a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

K Teetan reported that in the early stages when unable to cross SKY SONG he elected to come back to follow that runner which resulted in his mount settling further back in the field than what he had intended.
Jumped awkwardly.  Near the 600 Metres shifted in and made contact with WOODFIRE CHAMP.
Slow to begin.  Near the 150 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of WOODFIRE CHAMP to continue into clear running.

Shifted in at the start and made contact with EVER SMART.  H Bentley stated that he was instructed to take up a forward position.  He said SONIC BOOM was unable to show sufficient pace in the early stages to cross runners to his inside which resulted in his mount racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  He added that as a consequence SONIC BOOM was unable to finish the race off when under pressure in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Noted to have blood at the mouth after the race.

Bumped at the start.  Passing the 100 Metres was steadied to avoid BRILLIANT FIRE (D Probert) which shifted out.  D Probert was advised to exercise more care and to stop riding and straighten his mounts sooner when they shift ground whilst not clear.  L Hewitson could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

Near the 600  Metres was bumped.  M L Yeung could offer no excuse for his mount’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 500 Metres was steadied to avoid GREAT LEGACY when that runner was giving ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
Bumped at the start.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Bumped at the start. M L Yeung was reprimanded for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 2 consecutive strides near the 200 Metres.

Approaching the 1500 Metres was steadied when momentarily crowded between JOYFUL PROSPERITY and NOBLE PURSUIT which shifted in before being corrected by its rider H Bowman.  H Doyle reported that the intention was to hold a forward position but her mount jumped only fairly and then did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to hold a more forward position.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped only fairly.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Over the final 250 Metres was badly held up for clear running and as a consequence could not be ridden out to the finish.

Bumped at the start.  C L Chau stated that his mount, which was stepping up to the 1650 Metres tonight, would derive a benefit from tonight’s experience.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out and was then steadied to avoid FUN TOGETHER when that runner shifted in slightly.  Near the 350 Metres raced tight to the inside of GREAT LEGACY when that runner shifted in slightly whilst giving ground.

Bumped at the start.  M F Poon reported that he was given no specific instruction but when caught wide in the early stages he elected to allow his mount to stride forward to avoid covering additional ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The performance of GREAT LEGACY, which finished tailed out, was considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, GREAT LEGACY will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Was obliged to race wide and without cover from the 800 Metres.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed that from a wide barrier he had instructed M Guyon to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages to offset the wide barrier.  Noted to have multiple lacerations to the right hind leg after the race.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When the pace steadied approaching the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid WINNING DATA.  L Hewitson reported that in the Home Straight his mount hung in and proved difficult to ride out to the finish.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When the pace steadied approaching the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid SHINKANSEN.  Near the 750 Metres was steadied when crowded between QUANTUM PATCH and SHINKANSEN which shifted out when being steadied away from WINNING DATA.

When the pace steadied approaching the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid GOOD GOOD.  Held up on the Home Turn.  Leaving the 300 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of SHANGHAI STYLE in an endeavour to obtain clear running but then had some difficulty obtaining clear running between SHANGHAI STYLE and WORLD HERO near the 150 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Briefly held up on the Home Turn.

Bumped on jumping.  When the pace steadied approaching the 800 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid SHANGHAI STYLE.  Near the 700 Metres was steadied when crowded between SHINKANSEN and SHANGHAI STYLE.
When the pace steadied approaching the 800 Metres was steadied to avoid THE AZURE.

Bumped on jumping.  When questioned Apprentice E C W Wong stated that his instructions were to hold an on-pace position and obtain cover if possible.  He said after complying with his instructions in the early stages to hold an on-pace position RAGGA BOMB then improved to the lead leaving the 1400 Metres.  He stated when WORLD HERO improved to his outside he was content to allow that runner to cross but when RAGGA BOMB raced a little keenly this resulted in the horse holding the lead.  He added entering the Back Straight he applied further restraint to his mount to reduce the pace of the event, however, in retrospect he agreed with the Stewards that he had steadied the pace too quickly which resulted in a number of runners positioned behind him sustaining interference.  Apprentice Wong was advised that in similar circumstances he must ensure that when he attempts to reduce the pace of a race he must not do so too quickly to avoid causing interference to other runners.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly, shifted out and made contact with SHANGHAI STYLE.  When the pace steadied approaching the 800 Metres was checked to avoid QUICK CONTRIBUTION.  Between the 250 Metres and the 50 Metres was held up for clear running.
No report.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in at the start and made contact with WINNING CIGAR.  In the Home Straight lay in and proved difficult to ride out.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When questioned Z Purton stated that his instructions were to hold the lead in accordance with the horse’s usual racing pattern.  He said in the early stages after jumping well he obtained a position to the outside of LEAN MASTER and he had expected that horse not show as much pace as his mount and therefore he would be able to cross that runner.  He said when LEAN MASTER continued to hold its position to his inside entering the Back Straight he elected to allow WINNING MONEY to stride forward to cross that runner as he was of the opinion had he endeavoured to restrain his mount it would have commenced to race keenly and also as it has a tendency to hang out in its races.  He added as a consequence throughout the middle stages WINNING MONEY set a faster pace than he would have liked.  Trainer K W Lui confirmed the instructions issued and also agreed with Jockey Purton that WINNING MONEY has a tendency to race keenly and hang out when restrained.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Over the concluding stages raced tight between SUGAR SUGAR and GIANT BALLON which lay in.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 200 Metres made contact with HEROIC MASTER when being shifted to the inside of SPEEDY TRIDENT to continue into clear running.  Over the concluding stages was eased and shifted to the outside of GOLDEN LUCK to continue into clear running.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Over the final 100 Metres lay in and proved difficult to ride out to the finish of the race.
On jumping became unbalanced when bumped heavily by WINNING CIGAR.
On jumping made heavy contact with SPEEDY TRIDENT when crowded by GIANT BALLON.
No report.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  In the early stages raced keenly and for some distance near the 1000 Metres was steadied away from SPEEDY TRIDENT.  Near the 200 Metres was bumped by LAKESHORE HERO which shifted in.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Near the 300 Metres was steadied and shifted to the outside of KNOW AT HEART to obtain clear running.  In the Home Straight lay out and near the 200 Metres shifted out abruptly, resulting in its rider Y L Chung having to stop riding and straighten.  Over the final 100 Metres GOOD LUCK HAPPY then shifted out when it continued to lay out.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted in abruptly and became unbalanced.
Bumped at the start.
No report.

Near the 200 Metres was hampered and taken wider by GOOD LUCK HAPPY which shifted out.  L Ferraris stated that the intention was to hold a forward position.  He said when caught wide in the early stages he attempted to obtain cover.  He said when SONIC PURSUIT crossed to the one-off position near the 600 Metres this resulted in FATAL BLOW being obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter.
Jumped only fairly.

Jumped only fairly and then was crowded by KNOW AT HEART which jumped awkwardly and shifted in abruptly.  When commencing to finish the race off well was steadied near the 50 Metres when disappointed for clear running between YEE CHEONG SPIRIT and WINNING NOW and as a consequence was unable to be ridden out to the finish.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Shortly after the start was eased when racing in restricted room between GOLDEN BRILLIANT which was taken out by SONIC PURSUIT and CALIFORNIA BLITZ which shifted in slightly.  Near the 200 Metres was hampered and taken wider by FATAL BLOW.  M L Yeung stated that his mount was disadvantaged by the early and middle stages of the event being run inside of standard time which resulted in the horse not travelling well in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.

Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  A Atzeni could offer no excuse for the horse’s disappointing performance.  Trainer J Richards advised that the horse had pleased him prior to the race and the only explanation he could offer was that SONIC PURSUIT was disadvantaged by racing wide in the early stages.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Slow to begin.  Near the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid SNOWFIELD.  Approaching the 50 Metres was shifted to the outside of THE AUSPICIOUS to continue into clear running.

Jumped awkwardly.  After passing the winning post SNOWFIELD sustained an injury to the right front leg and was immediately treated by the Veterinarians.  After it was determined that the injury was too severe for the horse to be saved SNOWFIELD was euthanised.  Samples were taken from the horse.
No report.
No report.
No report.
Bumped on jumping.

H Bentley reported that his mount enjoyed a comfortable run during the race outside LIVEANDLETLIVE and did not quicken when asked for an effort in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Bumped on jumping.  H Bowman stated that from a wide barrier the connections agreed that the horse should be ridden in a conservative manner in the early stages.  He said ROMANTIC THOR raced too keenly during the race and as a result did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

L Hewitson stated that his mount was obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a result did not run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Bumped at the start.  L Hewitson pleaded guilty to a careless riding charge for causing interference approaching the 1000 Metres (see THE ALL OUT).  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shortly after the start made contact with SWEET BRIAR due to both runners shifting ground.  Sent for sampling post-race.
After travelling a short distance was hampered when crowded between GENIUS BABY and REWARDING BUDDY which shifted out.
After travelling a short distance bumped with FORTUNE WHISKEY and became unbalanced.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.
Near the 150 Metres was shifted to the outside of GLORY CLOUD to continue into clear running.

After travelling a short distance was checked to avoid GENIUS BABY when that runner was taken out. H Bowman was fined the sum of $10,000 for using the whip on consecutive occasions in 3 consecutive strides near the 150 Metres.

Approaching the 1000 Metres was bumped heavily on the hindquarters, resulting in JOLLY COMPANION becoming unbalanced.  H Doyle stated that after being heavily contacted on the hindquarters making the first turn she felt there may be something amiss with the horse and as a consequence she was reluctant to fully test it thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Lay out making the first turn.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, GLORY CLOUD will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shortly after the start made contact with REWARDING BUDDY due to both runners shifting ground.  H Bentley stated that his mount jumped awkwardly, made contact with AWESOME TREASURE and lost ground.  He said despite riding his mount along in the early stages SWEET BRIAR did not show sufficient pace to hold a more forward position.

L Hewitson (AWESOME TREASURE) pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that approaching the 1000 Metres he allowed his mount to shift in when not clear of THE ALL OUT, resulting in THE ALL OUT having to be restrained to avoid the heels of AWESOME TREASURE, shifting out and making contact with JOLLY COMPANION, resulting in THE ALL OUT having to be checked.  L Hewitson was suspended from riding in races for one Hong Kong raceday to be conducted on Thursday, 1 January 2026 at Sha Tin.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 2 and the consequences grade 2 and also considered his very good race riding record.   Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.

Shortly after the start made heavy contact with WONDER KIT due to both runners shifting ground, resulting in PERFECT GENERAL becoming unbalanced.  M Guyon, rider of the 4th placegetter, was severely reprimanded for failing to ride his mount out to the end of the race.  In assessing the incident the Stewards took into account the margin of a neck between the 3rd and 4th placegetters and were satisfied that his riding did not affect the horse’s finishing position.
Over the concluding stages raced tight between KING MILES and LUCKY PLANET which shifted out.
No report.

Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  Before being allowed to race again, LIM’S SHAVANO will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

L Ferraris stated that his mount came under pressure from the 500 Metres and was disappointing in its failure to run on in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between LIGHTNESS OF BEING and PERFECT GENERAL which was taken in by WONDER KIT.

Shortly after the start made heavy contact with PERFECT GENERAL due to both runners shifting ground.  B Avdulla stated that from the outside barrier his instructions were to take up an on-pace position.  He added that his mount came under pressure from the 600 Metres where he had some concerns with its action thereafter before it gave ground in the Home Straight.  Trainer Y S Tsui confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Before being allowed to race again, WONDER KIT will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Shortly after the start became badly unbalanced when bumped by FRIENDS OF SHAJING which shifted out slightly.  H Doyle stated that after being contacted heavily shortly after the start her mount failed to travel at any stage of the event thereafter.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

As the start was effected reared and as a consequence lost considerable ground.  The barrier manners of PRESTIGE SUPERIOR were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, PRESTIGE SUPERIOR will be required to perform to the satisfaction of the Stewards in a barrier trial.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover from the 800 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Shifted in at the start and made contact with TELECOM FIGHTERS.  Leaving the 250 Metres was shifted to the inside of REGAL GEM to obtain clear running.
Near the 150 Metres shifted in and made contact with REGAL GEM as it was being corrected by its rider.
Shortly after the start shifted in and away from HARMONY N BLESSED and made contact with I CAN.  Near the 150 Metres was eased when racing in restricted room between KAHOLO ANGEL and HUGE WAVE.

Near the 150 Metres was bumped by SOLEIL FIGHTER which shifted in before being corrected by its rider A Atzeni.  Z Purton stated that, in his opinion, the horse did not run out the 1650 Metres of tonight’s race.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly.  From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.
Shortly after the start was steadied when crowded between REGAL GEM and STEPS AHEAD which shifted in and away from HARMONY N BLESSED.

M L Yeung reported that his mount would be better suited by being stepped up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Jumped only fairly.  L Hewitson reported that making the turns in the middle stages his mount lay out towards I CAN and did not appear to appreciate racing around the Happy Valley circuit.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Became unbalanced when bumped at the start.  Trainer Y S Tsui stated that the instructions were to ride the horse with cover tonight as it had not been finishing its races off when leading.  He added TELECOM FIGHTERS settled slightly further back in the field than what he had anticipated.
No report.
